description: List the 16 dataset export formats FAQai supports, grouped by category: vector databases (Pinecone, Qdrant, pgvector, ChromaDB, Weaviate, Milvus, LanceDB, Upstash), frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex), evaluation (RAGAS/DeepEval), fine-tuning (JSONL), and general (JSON, CSV, Markdown, RAG Chunks). All formats are available on every paid plan. Use the format id with the export_dataset tool.
